text:
anya: quick flag 0min0ago0we onboarded ranky-mid-v1 int4 (fast-ptq) against longtail-prodset. Initial canary shows -3.8% NDCG@10 vs fp16, NDCG@1 -6.0%, MRR -2.6%.

kevin: is that aggregated or a slice? longtail could mean a lot of rare tokens.

anya: slice: queries with docs >300 tokens and queries that include code snippets or urls. Short queries look fine.

mireille: two immediate suspects: calibration distribution (generic calset) and tokenizer normalization mismatch between bench and prod html-stripping.

kevin: also check candidate ordering + dedupe parity. If bench shuffles candidates you can amplify top1 flips when logits get squashed.

ci-bot: CI: rerank-eval/4123337777 queued by anya  tag=ranky-mid-int4-fastptq, dataset=longtail-prodset/prod-preproc, config="fixed-order,no-kvcache" ETA ~22m

anya: running three jobs: 
- fp16 baseline (prod-preproc, fixed-order)
- int8 PTQ (same)
- int4 PTQ baseline (same)
I'll add int4-perchannel + tail-calset if baseline int4 still bad.

ci-bot: CI: job 4123337777-1 finished  fp16 baseline NDCG@10=0.389
ci-bot: CI: job 4123337777-2 finished  int8 NDCG@10=0.386 (-0.8% vs fp16)
ci-bot: CI: job 4123337777-3 finished  int4-fastptq NDCG@10=0.375 (-3.6% vs fp16)

mireille: confirms int4 gap. Can you paste 8 failure pairs? I'll inspect token splits and if URLs/tokenization shift rank signals.

kevin: before that try int4 with per-channel scales + calset=longtail-3k (include code/url heavy samples) and small post-rescale 0.97. Also test disabling prefix cache and switching concat order Q+D -> D+Q for long docs.

anya: queued int4-perchannel-longtail3k+rescale0.97 + no-kvcache + D+Q. cmd:

```
rerank-eval --model ranky-mid-v1 --quant int4-perchannel --calset longtail-3k \
  --dataset longtail-prodset --preproc prod-normalize --fix-order --no-kvcache \
  --concat-order D+Q --post-rescale 0.97
```

ci-bot: CI: job 4123337777-4 queued ETA ~28m

kevin: if that reduces gap we should add a "longtail-quant" holdout to CI with concat-order parity and kvcache disabled to catch regressions early.

mireille: if per-channel still noisy, consider mixing int8 fp16 routing for docs > 512 tokens. Also log per-layer activation max to find overflow/clipping.

ci-bot: CI: job 4123337777-4 finished  int4-perchannel-longtail3k+rescale0.97 NDCG@10=0.383 (-1.5% vs fp16)

anya: good recovery. I'll open PR to: (1) make per-channel PTQ default for ranking models, (2) add longtail-quant holdout with concat-order + kvcache parity, (3) add routing rule for docs>512 -> int8.

kevin: :thumbsup: also add short note in the onboarding checklist about calset composition and candidate-order parity.

mireille: please paste the failure pairs and a 1-paragraph summary for the model card so QA knows caveats.

anya: will paste failures + model-card blurb here once I extract them. thanks all.
